# ORION Web Studio

> ORION Web Studio is a web design, development, SEO/GEO and AWS cloud studio in Funchal, Madeira, Portugal, with 13 years of experience (since 2013), led by an AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate. Named after the Orion constellation, visible from every corner of the Earth. Serves businesses in Madeira, Portugal and worldwide.

## Key facts
- Name: ORION Web Studio (short: ORION); website: https://nexgen-fullstack.github.io/orion/
- What: web design and development studio — websites, online stores, web apps, SEO & GEO, Google Maps, Google Ads, AWS cloud and automation
- Based in: Funchal, Madeira, Portugal (works remotely worldwide; meets clients in person on Madeira)
- Experience: since 2013 (13 years), 100+ projects delivered
- Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (SAA-C03); AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (held by the studio's lead architect)
- Stack: React, Next.js, JavaScript, Python, Django, AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, CloudFront, Kinesis, CloudWatch), Terraform
- Marketing: SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), local SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Ads, link building
- Prices: websites from €199 (launch price for new clients); fixed price agreed before work starts; stores, web apps and cloud projects quoted individually
- Contact: WhatsApp / Viber +351 927 582 627 (https://wa.me/351927582627), Telegram @OrionWebStudio (https://t.me/OrionWebStudio), email connect@orionstudio.io
- Languages of the site and of delivered websites: English, Português, Українська, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Français, Русский

## Services
- **Websites & landing pages** — Custom-designed, lightning-fast websites that turn visitors into calls, bookings and sales. No templates — every detail crafted for your brand.
- **Web apps & online stores** — Booking systems, online stores, dashboards and client portals built with React, Next.js and Python — secure and ready to scale.
- **SEO & GEO** — Visibility in Google and in AI answers — ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity. Technical SEO, structured data, content and quality backlinks.
- **Google Maps & local SEO** — A complete Google Business Profile, review strategy and local signals so customers in Madeira find you first.
- **Google Ads & analytics** — Campaigns that pay for themselves, with conversion tracking set up correctly from day one.
- **Cloud & automation** — AWS infrastructure, serverless back-ends, CI/CD, data pipelines and AI integrations that save you hours every week.

## Selected work
- **Madeira Lead Engine** (Data · Automation) — A Python system that maps local businesses, audits their websites and scores each one from 0 to 100 to find who needs help most — with Excel and interactive HTML reports.
- **Instant Demo Sites** (Web · Generator) — A generator that builds a personalised multilingual website for any business in minutes — in PT · EN · DE · ES · IT · FR · UA — so the owner sees the result before paying a cent.
- **CloudScale Optimizer** (AWS · Serverless) — Automated multi-region cost optimisation: right-sizes EC2 nodes and shuts down idle resources based on CloudWatch events.
- **Velocity Event Stream** (Data pipeline) — High-throughput event ingestion and transformation with AWS Kinesis, Go workers and compressed S3 cold storage.

## How a project works
1. **Discovery call** — A short call to understand your business, your goals and who your clients are.
2. **Strategy & design** — Structure, texts and a unique design concept — you approve it before a single line of code.
3. **Development** — A fast, responsive, SEO-ready build. You follow the progress on a live preview link.
4. **Launch** — Domain, hosting, analytics, Google Maps and Search Console — all set up for you.
5. **Growth** — SEO, ads and updates that keep new clients coming every month.

## FAQ
### What is ORION?
ORION (ORION Web Studio) is a web design and development studio in Funchal, Madeira, Portugal. We design and build websites, online stores, web apps and AWS cloud systems for businesses in Madeira and worldwide. The studio has 13 years of experience and is led by an AWS Certified Solutions Architect. The name comes from the Orion constellation — visible from every corner of the Earth, just like the brands we help to shine.

### Do you only work with businesses in Madeira?
No. We work remotely with clients across Portugal, Europe and worldwide. In Madeira we can also meet in person.

### How long does it take to build a website?
A business website or landing page usually takes 1–3 weeks from the first call to launch. Web apps and online stores are planned individually.

### How much does a website cost?
Websites start from €199 — a launch price for new clients. The exact fixed price is agreed after a short call, before work starts — no hidden costs. Online stores, web apps and cloud projects are quoted individually.

### What is GEO and why does my business need it?
GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) prepares your site so AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity understand and recommend your business. We add structured data, clear answers and the technical signals AI search relies on.

### Can my website be in several languages?
Yes. We build multilingual websites in English, Portuguese, German, Spanish, Italian, French, Ukrainian and other languages. Each language gets its own page with correct hreflang tags, so Google and AI assistants show every visitor the right version.

### Can you take care of hosting, domain and updates?
Yes. Domain, hosting, SSL, backups, analytics and ongoing updates can all be handled for you, so you can focus on your business.
